title: Enterprise RAG Readiness
description: Review sources, permissions, freshness, retrieval, evaluation, trust, and operations.
body:
# Enterprise RAG Readiness

- [ ] Source owner and system of record identified
- [ ] Freshness and deletion SLA defined
- [ ] Identity reaches retrieval
- [ ] ACL metadata is indexed and tested
- [ ] Representative query dataset exists
- [ ] Retrieval and generation are evaluated separately
- [ ] Citations are visible and verifiable
- [ ] Cost, latency, fallback, and monitoring are defined
